components.text: Sign in to the hosted Gitea.com account you want to connect. This guide binds the exact https://gitea.com origin; self-hosted Gitea instances require a separately reviewed host policy.

Open Gitea.com Settings → Applications and create a personal access token with read:user for the identity test. Grant other scopes only for the operations you plan to use. Copy the token when created and enter it in the protected field; the API sends Authorization: token.

Test makes read-only GET https://gitea.com/api/v1/user and checks the returned user ID. A successful identity test does not prove access to every other operation. Save encrypts the token. After token rotation, replace the saved Ragentic credential on the Credentials page and test again.
Independent connector for Gitea.com. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Gitea.
